blocks.text: Thirty-five years ago, long before Focus Global Inc. had multi-level showrooms filled with beautifully designed kitchens, furniture and appliances, Stephen Sy (Founder, Chairman and President) and Loli Sy (Founder, Vice Chairman and Executive Vice President) were working out of a rented warehouse with 20 employees, two small office rooms, a mezzanine that doubled as lunchroom and meeting space, and a single shared bathroom. It was a modest beginning. But even then, Steve and Loli were already laying the groundwork for something much bigger. Steve’s vision was to bring world-class brands and quality to Filipino homes.
